title: Leo, 500 CFA francs, Zodiac signs
descriptionPlain: Description Leo is a Fire sign—radiating energy, confidence, and natural charisma. People born under this sign are distinguished by strength of character, courage, and a desire to be at the center of attention. The silver coin featuring Leo is not only a unique collector’s item, but also a personal talisman of leadership and inspiration, emphasizing the owner’s pride and authenticity
